sentences.en: As chair of the town council subcommittee on park facilities, I'd like to bring you up to date on some of the changes that have been made recently to the Croft Valley Park.
sentences.zh: 作为镇议会公园设施小组委员会主席，我想向各位简要介绍近期对克罗夫特山谷公园所做的一些变更。

sentences.en: So if you could just take a look at the map handed out, let's begin with a general overview.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果各位能看一下分发的地图，我们先从整体概况开始。

sentences.en: So the basic arrangement of the park hasn't changed - it still has two gates, north and south, and a lake in the middle.
sentences.zh: 公园的基本布局没有改变——它仍然有两个大门，北门和南门，以及位于中央的湖泊。

sentences.en: The café continues to serve an assortment of drinks and snacks and is still in the same place, looking out over the lake and next to the old museum.
sentences.zh: 咖啡馆继续提供各种饮品和小吃，位置也保持不变，依然面朝湖泊，毗邻老博物馆。

sentences.en: We're hoping to change the location of the toilets, and bring them nearer to the centre of the park as they're a bit out of the way at present, near the adventure playground, in the corner of your map.
sentences.zh: 我们计划将厕所的位置进行调整，使其更靠近公园中心，因为目前它们的位置有些偏僻，位于您地图角落的冒险游乐场附近。

sentences.en: The formal gardens have been replanted and should be at their best in a month or two.
sentences.zh: 正式花园已重新栽种，预计在一两个月内将达到最佳观赏状态。

sentences.en: They used to be behind the old museum, but we've now used the space near the south gate between the park boundary and the path that goes past the lake towards the old museum.
sentences.zh: 它们原先位于老博物馆后方，但现在我们已将空间改用在南门附近、公园边界与通往老博物馆并经过湖泊的小径之间。

sentences.en: We have a new outdoor gym for adults and children, which is already proving very popular.
sentences.zh: 我们新建了一处供成人和儿童使用的户外健身区，目前已广受欢迎。

sentences.en: It's by the glass houses, just to the right of the path from the south gate.
sentences.zh: 它位于玻璃温室旁，就在从南门进入的小路右侧。

sentences.en: You have to look for it as it's a bit hidden in the trees.
sentences.zh: 您需要稍加留意才能找到它，因为它被树木略微遮挡。

sentences.en: One very successful introduction has been our skateboard ramp.
sentences.zh: 一项非常成功的新增设施是我们的滑板坡道。

sentences.en: It's in constant use during the evenings and holidays.
sentences.zh: 它在傍晚和假期期间始终处于高使用率状态。

sentences.en: It's near the old museum, at the end of a little path that leads off from the main path between the lake and the museum.
sentences.zh: 它位于老博物馆附近，处在一条从湖与博物馆之间主路分岔而出的小路尽头。

sentences.en: We've also introduced a new area for wild flowers, to attract bees and butterflies.
sentences.zh: 我们还开辟了一片新的野花种植区，以吸引蜜蜂和蝴蝶。

sentences.en: It's on a bend in the path that goes round the east side of the lake. just south of the adventure.
sentences.zh: 它位于环绕湖泊东侧的小路弯道处，就在冒险游乐场正南方。

sentences.en: playground.
sentences.zh: 游乐场。

sentences.en: Now let me tell you a bit more about some of the changes to Croft Valley Park.
sentences.zh: 现在让我再向各位详细介绍一些克罗夫特山谷公园的变更。

sentences.en: One of our most exciting developments has been the adventure playground.
sentences.zh: 其中最令人振奋的开发项目之一便是冒险游乐场。

sentences.en: We were aware that we had nowhere for children to let off steam, and decided to use our available funds to set up a completely new facility in a large space to the north of the park.
sentences.zh: 我们意识到此前园内缺乏让儿童释放精力的场所，因此决定利用现有资金，在公园北部一大片空地上全新建设一处设施。

sentences.en: It's open year-round, though it closes early in the winter months, and entrance is completely free.
sentences.zh: 该游乐场全年开放，尽管冬季月份会提早关闭，且入场完全免费。

sentences.en: Children can / choose whatever activities they want to do, irrespective of their age, but we do ask adults not /018 to leave them on their own there.
sentences.zh: 儿童可自由选择任何活动，不受年龄限制；但我们确实要求成人不可将孩子单独留在那里。

sentences.en: There are plenty of seats where parents can relax and keep an eye on their children at the same time.
sentences.zh: 现场设有大量座椅，方便家长放松休息的同时照看自己的孩子。

sentences.en: Lastly, the glass houses.
sentences.zh: 最后，谈谈玻璃温室。

sentences.en: A huge amount of work has been done on them to repair the damage following the disastrous fire that recently destroyed their western side.
sentences.zh: 为修复近期那场灾难性火灾所造成的损毁（火灾摧毁了其西侧），我们已投入大量人力物力。

sentences.en: Over £80,000 / was spent on replacing the glass walls and the metal supports, as well as the plants that had been destroyed, although unfortunately the collection of tropical palm trees has proved too expensive to replace up to now.
sentences.zh: 超过8万英镑的资金被用于更换玻璃墙体、金属支撑结构以及被焚毁的植物；不过遗憾的是，热带棕榈树收藏因成本过高，至今尚未能复原。

sentences.en: At present the glass houses are open from 10am to 3pm Mondays to Thursdays, and it's hoped to extend this to the weekend soon.
sentences.zh: 目前玻璃温室的开放时间为每周一至周四上午10点至下午3点，我们希望不久后能将开放时间延长至周末。

sentences.en: We're grateful to / all those who helped us by contributing their time and money to this achievement.
sentences.zh: 我们衷心感谢所有为这一成就贡献了时间和金钱的人士。

sentences.en: The gardens have
sentences.zh: 花园已
